source_anchor_role: Common completed split-fulfilment A source; no A treatment effect is estimated

R.provenance: B repeats the v2 feature class; D is informed by the v2 post-run refund diagnostic. Development family, not independent confirmation.

W.provenance: Distinct pressure chosen before v3 output; shares the A fixture and therefore is not an independent codebase replication.

stage_profile_rule: Exact provider model/class and runner settings may vary between B,C,D when declared at workflow dispatch before coding; all three arms must match within each family-stage block. Record unavailable backend revision as unknown.
brief_visibility: Only the current stage brief is copied into a candidate worktree; later briefs, assessor and other outputs are host-only.
primary_pass_policy: Every due hidden finding must pass; invalid is reported separately and is never a pass.

resource_caps.note: Enforce and record episode wall cap; token target is advisory unless a supported hard cap and complete usage trace are available.

decision_threshold.scope: Local feasibility decision in each family, not a population inference or a financial saving
